why: Informal reaction; "Great!" vs "Cool!" is a tone choice.
Chinese 你多大 is a casual, direct question; asking age this directly can sound blunt in English.

pt: Está muito caro! Faz mais barato.
en: That's too expensive! Make it cheaper.
why: Bargaining phrase; more idiomatic alternatives: "Can you lower the price a bit?"
Source says 块 (kuai, colloquial yuan); "yuan" plural in English is usually unchanged.

pt: Eu gosto de fazer exercício, mas agora não está bom (pra isso).
en: I like sports, but I'm not well enough for that right now.
why: Chinese 现在不好 is vague; sense inferred as "not in good shape for it now".

pt: Quero! Fazer exercício é ainda melhor que assistir filme.
en: Yes! Exercising is even better than watching movies.
why: Comparative 更好 rendered as "even better".

pt: Ótimo, eu tenho tempo livre em ambos os dias!
en: Good, I'm free on both days!
why: Chinese 都 (both/all) with Friday and Sunday implied; kept as "both days".

pt: Ontem eu não jantei, hoje estou com muita fome.
en: Yesterday I didn't eat dinner, so I'm very hungry today.
why: Added "so" to make the cause-effect natural; source just lists both facts.
Distractor; must stay clearly wrong versus "Is a student" (and unlike the hospital option).
